explanation: The response only asserts generically that HEA composition and rapid cooling can improve glass-forming ability. This weakly matches the broad topic but does not reconstruct the identified material, compositional intervention, melt-spinning conditions, eutectic/phosphide mechanism, amorphous-ribbon outcome, or bulk-versus-ribbon boundary.
